title: LINE Group Chat Entertainer Bot
description: A LINE Messaging API bot that acts as an entertainer in group chats — answering questions, playing mini-games, chatting naturally with AI-powered responses. Supports multiple groups simultaneously with per-group persona customization.

estimated_earnings.notes: Basic bot setup $150-$300; advanced AI entertainer with custom persona $400-$800. Monthly hosting/maintenance retainer $50-$100/mo. LINE bots popular in Thailand, Japan, Taiwan markets.

risk_notes: LINE API is stable and well-documented. Main risks: LINE rate limits (1000 push messages/month on free plan), webhook downtime, group admin removing the bot.

freelance_platforms.notes: Chatbot gigs are top-sellers. Search: LINE bot, LINE chatbot, LINE Messaging API
Post as 'LINE Bot Developer' or 'LINE Messaging API Expert'. Thai/Japanese clients actively seek LINE bot devs.
Competitive bidding. Niche keyword: LINE Official Account bot
Facebook groups like 'Freelance IT Thailand', 'LINE Bot Thailand Community'

apis.name: LINE Messaging API
key_features: Webhook events (message, join, leave, follow, unfollow, postback)

packages.name: line-bot-sdk
packages.purpose: Official LINE Messaging API SDK for Python

packages.name: flask
packages.purpose: WSGI web framework for webhook endpoint

packages.name: requests
packages.purpose: HTTP client for optional external API calls (weather, jokes, etc.)

infrastructure.notes: LINE requires HTTPS webhook URL. Use ngrok for local dev.
